objective: Design exactly one falsifiable A versus A+B experiment. A is every fresh Short-MA cross above Medium-MA event at one frozen MA parameter set. A+B uses the same trigger, MA periods, D+1 entry, outcome horizon, universe and chronological split, adding only one discovery-selected orderingState filter. Specify how discovery chooses B, how validation stays untouched, which incremental metrics are compared, and what evidence falsifies B. Do not implement code or change parameters while evaluating B.

inputs.anchor: An ordering state is context only.

constraints: Ordering state is context, not trigger
A and A+B must keep identical MA parameters
Do not inspect validation while choosing B
Do not add a threshold to rescue results
